transitions.when: no AMBITION.md or ledger older than last aim
every quest Recorded and the aim's statements carry a regime

quest.sink_exit_rule: a quest leaves a sink only by the transition that fixes it, performed by the agent already holding the context

transitions.when: root died or wait never wakes

G1.passes: named foundation files appear as whole reads in the coordinator's own transcript

G2.passes: every quest has brief, budget in swarm-hours, machine, worktree-or-main, evaluator

G3.passes: budget exhausted or doctrine contradiction or ember.aim

G4.passes: doctrine rewritten not appended; replaced modules deleted in the same commit

Q1.passes: deliverable equals the aim's; estimate in swarm-hours with a cv stats comparable

Q2.passes: runs on real inputs in the real tree; no sim/mock/stub/fallback/browser twin on the load-bearing path

Q3.passes: imported by, exported to, or emitted for the live system; no Rust twin without a call or an emitted artifact

Q4.passes: planted bad input refused; no structural-only tests

Q5.passes: on main, named paths, no stash, no add -A, no surviving branch, superseded path deleted

Q6.passes: each statement labelled decided/certified/attested with inhabited hypothesis families

Q7.passes: one ledger row; docs cite real names and address a reader; no confession prose; no counts as achievements

S1.passes: length reached; forget note written from artifacts

S2.passes: context pressure above threshold or two compactions

S3.passes: source retired and routes updated to the successor

S4.passes: fork only below the large-context threshold

S5.passes: handoff direction per the handoff tax

Label.detector: residual name with no inhabitation (Q3, Q6)
Label.exit: close the gap; delete the name

Ritual.detector: cv events: last N rounds re-run pins/vectors/audits with no new artifact or claim
Ritual.exit: give the segment a deliverable or retire it

Stalled.exit: do the deferred thing; match every deferral to a quest

EmberGated.detector: message contains the decision and asks permission; destructive actions excepted

Lost.detector: cv doctor compactions with no whole reads since; claims citing .md and no code

SummaryRebuilt.detector: fresh agent briefed from a summary while the scout's transcript exists
SummaryRebuilt.exit: cv distill or cv adopt; the scout becomes the doer

Miscalibrated.detector: estimate over one swarm-week without a comparable

Shrunk.detector: brief deliverable is a subset of the aim; pillar closed without a decision row
Shrunk.exit: restore the aim; split into quests

SideBranched.detector: stash, branch older than its segment, add -A, revert of another lane's commit
SideBranched.exit: land on main with named files

Mirror.detector: Rust semantic object with no Lean source, emitted artifact or FFI call
Mirror.exit: Lean definition, then emit or call

HarnessLoss.detector: cv lanes after a root dies
HarnessLoss.exit: cv adopt; PID files; never respawn from a summary

Slow.detector: identical expensive command twice; a build on the Mac; a wait with no tee'd log
Slow.exit: tee once; build on the box; measure once

Navel.detector: lint class 9; process narration added to a reader's document
Navel.exit: rewrite for the reader or delete

Scar.detector: replacement landed and superseded module still reachable or on disk

Stomped.detector: paths outside the lane's named set; kill not by PID file; delete outside scratchpad
Stomped.exit: revert only the lane's own change

Alone.detector: no AMBITION.md or ledger older than last aim
Alone.exit: write the aim; the ledger is the plan
